multiple_rationale: Author-selected 4x/6x/8x/10x mechanical sensitivities, not sourced market comparables, investment recommendations or fair-value estimates.
settlement_rationale: Assume both convertible note issues settle at cash principal without conversion, premium or accrued interest. Actual conversion rights, capped calls, dilution and transaction settlement terms require separate work; no per-share value or proceeds is calculated.
unresolved_items: No transaction date, payoff letter, accrued-interest schedule or verified conversion/capped-call treatment.
No verified split between unrestricted surplus cash, required operating cash and restricted or trapped balances.
No complete debt-like item, nonoperating asset, tax or fee diligence; explicit zero assumptions do not establish absence.
Historical November 30, 2025 balances and annual earnings predate the September 2026 Domo acquisition. They do not represent the current capital structure.
Calculated EBITDA is not normalized or issuer-adjusted EBITDA; reported recurring expenses remain and no constructed operating uplift is added.

scenarios.label: All reported cash available
scenarios.cash_rationale: Illustrative upper availability assumption; restricted, trapped or required operating cash has not been verified.
scenarios.lease_rationale: The calculated EBITDA retains operating rent. Exclude operating lease liabilities for this after-rent earnings convention; no lease-adjusted comparable multiple is asserted.

nonoperating_assets.rationale: No separately verified realizable nonoperating asset is credited; this is an explicit assumption, not proof that none exist.

other_claims.rationale: Illustration assumes no incremental debt-like claims. Accrued interest, change-of-control terms, taxes, contingent obligations and all other claims require diligence.

transaction_costs.rationale: No transaction has been proposed; fees and payoff costs are unknown. Zero is an explicit sensitivity input, not a transaction estimate.
